title: Using Finch Notes — Finch Circle Loyalty Program Redemption Terms
content:
A Finch Note of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program is applied to a Marlowe & Finch purchase in store, online or in the app, on these terms:

1. **Unexpired.** The purchase date is on or before the note's expiry date. The comparison is inclusive and allows a grace of 0 days: a purchase on the expiry date itself is in time, and a purchase on the day after is not. The expiry date is read from the note's issue entry in the member's note history, for the note code being applied.
2. **Unused.** The note has not already been redeemed or lapsed, as the note history shows for that note code.
3. **Status.** The membership is in active status, as the membership record shows it.
4. **Single use.** A note is consumed whole: when it is larger than the eligible amount the rest is forfeited; it never gives change and has no cash value.
5. **Limit.** At most the tier's notes per transaction are applied to one purchase transaction.
6. **Exclusions.** Notes never apply to gift cards, alteration, delivery and shipping fees, or sales tax.
7. **No earn on notes.** The amount paid with notes is not qualifying spend and earns no points.

The per-tier limit on notes per transaction is that of the Finch Note schedule.

## Boundary of the expiry test (hypothetical)

| Note expiry date | Purchase date | Within term 1 |
|---|---|---|
| 15 August | 14 August | yes |
| 15 August | 15 August | yes (on the expiry date) |
| 15 August | 16 August | no |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A Finch Circle Gold member buys a sweater of 62.00 plus sales tax, using two 10.00 notes. The notes cover 20.00 of the merchandise and none of the tax; the qualifying amount that earns points is the 42.00 not paid with notes. A 10.00 note applied to a basket with only 7.00 of eligible merchandise is consumed whole; 3.00 is forfeited.
